**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Recover the brain session after a 5-hour memory gap, measure where #682 and the milestones stand, read all 71 open issues + epic #313 + master plan docs, and trace a leak-free staged plan for M5 (role-as-port) and M8 (stage→engine router).

## Instructions
- Reply in Rioplatense Spanish; artifacts in the project's language (Spanish for inbox-style docs).
- Never merge/self-approve; human signs tickets. Agent files `status:needs-review` and stops.

## Discoveries
- Previous session ended at ~01:34 UTC 20/08 without a session summary; reconstructed from `gh pr list --state all` — PR bodies carried the measurement census.
- #682: 15/21 tasks (71%), slices 2/3, REQs 5/6 (REQ-682-5 orphan), 27 commits on feature/issue-682, NO PR to main → 0% shipped. Reproduces #713's class.
- M5 and M8 at 0%. REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS has 9 consumers. ADR-0024:53-55 says M8 needs supersede; #323 argues amend — unresolved, human gate.
- #456 ordering contradiction (#576 last vs #713 first) resolved by its body: starts now, closes after #323 → two slices.
- Label hygiene: #745 carries both status labels; #732 #699 #697 #327 #268 have none. Handoff doc: 3/4 expiry invariants failed (main sha, count, npm 404→200).
- resolve-challenger.mjs exists on the tracker (PR #740), not main; design.md records the M5 debt (delete binding half when #312 lands).

## Accomplished
- Engram catch-up record #2840 (topic sdd/issue-682/state); plan record #2845 (topic roadmap/m5-m8-plan).
- Five sub-agent surveys (issues in 3 ranges, M5/M8 code+ADR surface, milestone board) — their discoveries saved by them.
- Published artifact "Del reviewer al router": https://claude.ai/code/artifact/63bcffb1-67ce-47fc-80f4-4e8657076822 (6 stages, 5 human gates, 10 leaks, side lanes).

## Next Steps
- Maintainer: rule the 5 gates (M8 ADR supersede/amend; model_tier shape; parity backends; single config verb #743/#323; sign #357 A). Sign #750 #745 #746 #752 #754. Fix label hygiene.
- Stage 0: fix #750 on tracker, slice 3 of #682 + REQ-682-5 task, terminal PR feature/issue-682→main, clean 17 untracked .memory records + stale agent worktrees.
- Stage 2 prereqs in parallel: #316, #643 (with config-migration pattern), #456 slice A, #605, re-measure #312.
- Optional: land the plan as docs/inbox/ PR if the maintainer wants it in-tree.

## Relevant Files
- openspec/changes/issue-682-independence-axis-ruling/{tasks,design}.md (on feature/issue-682) — slice 3 unticked; M5 debt recorded
- brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs:99 VALID_OPS; brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.mjs:68 REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS; harness/backends/agent-runtime.mjs:206-211 dead harness branch
- brain/project/decisions/adr-0019, adr-0024, brain-drafts/adr-0023 — doctrine constraints for M8
- docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md, MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md, brain-v2-epic-plan.md — stale; do not answer status from them
